verdict.rationale: Unstructured's security docs claim SOC 2 Type 2 audited controls and HIPAA compliance for PHI, which covers contracts and medical records. It also offers dedicated instance/VPC deployment with full data isolation, encryption and private connectivity. No evidence shows zero-retention handling of uploaded documents; VPC isolation is the nearest substitute. Missing for 10: explicit zero-retention/no-storage policy for uploaded files, BAA or HIPAA option details, independent corroboration of the compliance claims.
